creators.name: LINHÉ (Linh)
creators.following: German lifestyle, travel and food blogger with a multi-year, findable body of work including a dedicated Aachen food guide ('Aachen Foodguide: Die besten Cafés & Restaurants in Aachen').
creators.credible: Verifiable, established creator with a specific published piece naming Aachen places. Used here only as a corroborating source (e.g. Gold of Naples) alongside official Aachen-Tourismus listings, never as a lone recommender.
creators.note: Corroborating lead for Pontstraße / central Aachen casual dining; each place cross-checked against aachen-tourismus.de or another credible outlet.
